description: Score quantization: clamp to [0, 1], then round to the nearest 0.1 with ties toward +Infinity (JavaScript Math.round(x * 10) / 10 on the clamped value; floor(x * 10 + 0.5) / 10 is non-conformant at IEEE edges). NaN, +Infinity and -Infinity cannot be expressed in JSON, so they have no vectors here; v1.md section 6 specifies them and every SDK must test them itself: each fails closed to 0 (+Infinity is not clamped to 1).

cases.name: IEEE edge: 0.049999999999999996 rounds to 0 (naive floor(x*10+0.5) gives 0.1)
